'''Mitchell''' (Japanese: '''ミツキ''' ''Mitsuki'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He attended [[Professor Rowan]]'s [[Pokémon Summer Academy]] and was on the Red Team alongside {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. 

==History==
While his first appearance was in ''[[DP088|Camping It Up!]]'', he didn't receive a speaking role until ''[[DP090|Ghoul Daze!]]''. He paired up with  {{an|Brock}} for the fourth day activity, in which students had to find the Summit Medal in the [[Summit Ruins]] at night. As the path leading to the ruins is inhabited by many {{type|Ghost}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, Mitchell was afraid though Brock taught him how to befriend any type of Pokémon by giving them {{pkmn|food}}.
